Specialista infermieristico HF, posizione fissa al 50-100% La Clinica Ergolz è un piccolo ospedale privato con un'ampia gamma di pazienti chirurgici e una clinica cardiaca ambulatoriale. Per ampliare il nostro team, cerchiamo un infermiere HF qualificato, motivato e impegnato, immediatamente o su appuntamento.

Il tuo profilo:

Se apprezzi la collegialità, la lealtà e lo spirito di squadra e hai una formazione come specialista infermieristico qualificato (AKP/HF/FH/DNII), allora ti adatterai perfettamente al nostro team. Idealmente, hai diversi anni di esperienza professionale in un ospedale per malattie acute e sei un formatore professionale qualificato o sei interessato a completare un'adeguata formazione continua. Agisci con calma in situazioni impegnative, sei resiliente, motivato e disposto a lavorare in tutti e 3 i turni. Attraverso la vostra esperienza, cordialità, conoscenze specialistiche e capacità organizzative contribuite al benessere dei nostri pazienti e sostenete la collaborazione professionale nel nostro team. Sei caratterizzato da buone capacità comunicative. Azioni responsabili e un elevato livello di attenzione, nonché un modo di lavorare indipendente e affidabile completano il tuo profilo.

I tuoi compiti:

• Assistenza e supporto professionale, tenendo conto dell'individuo

bisogni dei nostri pazienti

• Partecipazione attiva ai processi lavorativi apportando le proprie competenze personali

Punti di forza e competenze professionali

• Creazione e aggiornamento della pianificazione assistenziale e della corretta documentazione

• Effettuare cure di base e terapeutiche

• Valutazione, valutazione e azione delle situazioni di cura

• Buona collaborazione interdisciplinare e completa

• Rispetto delle istruzioni e degli ordini

• Eseguire regolamenti

• Impostazione e fatturazione di farmaci e materiali

• Ordinazione e distribuzione del cibo

Nursing Specialist HF, 50-100% permanent position The Ergolz Clinic is a small private hospital with a wide range of surgical patients as well as an outpatient cardiac clinic. To expand our team, we are looking for a motivated and committed qualified HF nurse immediately or by appointment.

Your profile:

If you value collegiality, loyalty and team spirit and have training as a qualified nursing specialist (AKP/HF/FH/DNII), then you will fit perfectly into our team. Ideally, you have several years of professional experience in an acute hospital and are a trained vocational trainer or are interested in completing appropriate further training. You act calmly in demanding situations, are resilient, motivated and willing to work in all 3 shifts. Through your experience, friendliness, specialist knowledge and organizational skills, you contribute to the well-being of our patients and support the professional collaboration in our team. You are characterized by good communication skills. Responsible actions and a high level of attentiveness as well as an independent and reliable way of working round off your profile.

Your tasks:

• Professional care and support, taking into account the individual

needs of our patients

• Active participation in the work processes by contributing your personal skills

Strengths and professional skills

• Creation and updating of care planning and correct documentation

• Carrying out basic and treatment care

• Assessment, assessment and action of care situations

• Good interdisciplinary and comprehensive collaboration

• Carrying out medical procedures in the recovery room and on the ward

• Compliance with instructions and orders

• Execute regulations

• Setting up and billing medications and materials

• Food ordering and distribution

Ergolz Clinic | Hammerstrasse 35 | 4410 Liestal | Switzerland Telephone +41 61 906 92 92 | Fax +41 61 906 92 70 ergolz-klinik@cardiance.com | www.cardiance.com

• Regular participation in team meetings and internal training

Our range:

We offer you a modern infrastructure, a familiar and well-coordinated team as well as a varied and responsible job. You can look forward to attractive working hours, five weeks of vacation and fair pay. You can also expect an appreciative working environment and flat hierarchies.

• Contemporary working conditions with fair pay

• The duty and operational planning takes place within the framework of the approximately three-month period

Planning in advance and, as far as operationally possible, taking employee wishes into account

• Paid changing time

• Paid breaks

• External and internal services individually tailored to your needs

Further training opportunities

• Free drinks (mineral water, coffee and tea)

• Shared use of cardio rehabilitation equipment

• Central location in Liestal, near “Frenkendorf-Füllinsdorf” train station, parking lot

Inquiry

• You may have the opportunity to continue your training in the direction of vocational training

Corpo: Terapista del cuore – 40–60 % Descrizione La Clinica Ergolz di Liestal (BL) fa parte del Gruppo Cardiance e offre un ambiente professionale in medicina, cura, terapia, amministrazione e servizio. --- Mansioni - Pianificazione e realizzazione di terapie individuali e di gruppo - Regolazione individuale della formazione tenendo conto delle esigenze mediche - Istruzione, motivazione e formazione dei pazienti - Documentazione terapeutica e valutazione dei corsi - Collaborazione attiva nei processi edilizi/offre (fasi rie II/III) - Facoltativamente a seconda della qualifica/interest: formazione di forza, procedure di respirazione/stress, gestione dello stress, formati di corso (ad esempio yoga di cuore/terapia dell'acqua) ---
• Requisiti - Formazione completa o studi nell'assistenza sanitaria (ad es. fisioterapia, terapia sportiva, cura con qualifica cardiologica aggiuntiva o studi in scienze dello sport, del movimento o della salute) - Accreditato ulteriore qualifica nella terapia cardiaca - Valida qualifica di emergenza BLS-AED - Esperienza nelle fasi di riabilitazione e riabilitazione cardiaca ambulatoriale II e III - Avviamento professionale benvenuto con corrispondente qualifica aggiuntiva --- Cosa? - Progettare una nuova offerta di riabilitazione ambulatoriale - Formazione di emergenza interna trimestrale - Lavoro interdisciplinare con brevi percorsi decisionali - Moderne infrastrutture e ambiente professionale --- Contatto Si prega di inviare le vostre domande a: Signora Jeannette Leu j.leu.ergolz-klinik@hin.ch --- Clinica: Ergolz Klinik, Liestal (BL) Indirizzo: Hammerstrasse 35, 4410 Liestal, Svizzera Telefono: +41 61 906 92 92 Fax: +41 61 906 92 70 Sito web: www.cardiance.com --- *La Clinica Ergolz di Liestal fa parte della pianificazione ospedaliera cantonale dal 2012. Siamo aperti a tutte le classi di assicurazione e offriamo servizi medici ambulatoriale. Le nostre aree specialistiche includono cardiologia, chirurgia generale, urologia, chirurgia ENT e ortopedia. *
descriptionByLocale.en:
Body: Heart Therapist – 40–60 % descrizione The Ergolz Clinic in Liestal (BL) is part of the Cardiance Group and offers a professional environment in medicine, care, therapy, administration and service. --- Mansioni - Planning and implementation of individual and group therapies - Individual training adjustment taking into account medical requirements - Instruction, motivation and training of patients - Therapeutic documentation and course assessment - Active cooperation in building processes/offerings (Reha phases II/III) - Optionally depending on the qualification/interest: strength training, breathing/destressing procedures, stress management, course formats (e.g. heart yoga/water therapy) ---
• Requisiti - Complete training or studies in health care (e.g. physiotherapy, sports therapy, care with cardiological additional qualification or studies in sports, movement or health sciences) - Accredited additional qualification in cardiac therapy - Valid emergency qualification BLS-AED - Experience in outpatient cardiac rehabilitation and rehabilitation phases II and III - Professional starters welcome with corresponding additional qualification ---
• Cosa offriamo - Designing a new outpatient rehabilitation offer - Quarterly internal emergency training - Interdisciplinary work with short decision paths - Modern infrastructure and a professional environment --- Contatto Please send your applications to: Mrs Jeannette Leu j.leu.ergolz-klinik@hin.ch --- Clinic: Ergolz Klinik, Liestal (BL) Address: Hammerstrasse 35, 4410 Liestal, Switzerland Telephone: +41 61 906 92 92 Fax: +41 61 906 92 70 Sito web: www.cardiance.com | Career page --- *The Ergolz Clinic in Liestal has been part of the cantonal hospital planning since 2012. We are open to all insurance classes and offer outpatient medical services. Our specialist areas include cardiology, general surgery, urology, ENT surgery and orthopaedics. *
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Ergolz Klinik in Liestal (BL) ist Teil der Cardiance Group und bietet ein professionelles Umfeld in Medizin, Pflege, Therapie, Administration und Service. Stelle: Herztherapeut/in, 40 - 60%. Ergolz Klinik | Hammerstrasse 35 | 4410 Liestal | Schweiz Telefon +41 61 906 92 92 | Fax +41 61 906 92 70 ergolz-klinik@cardiance.com | www.cardiance.com Herztherapeut/-in – 40 bis 60% Ergolz Klinik, Liestal (BL) Für den Aufbau unserer neuen ambulanten kardiologischen Rehabilitation suchen wir eine qualifizierte und engagierte Fachperson. Ihre Aufgaben
• Planung und Durchführung von Einzel- und Gruppentherapien
• Individuelle Trainingsanpassung unter Berücksichtigung ärztlicher Vorgaben
• Anleitung, Motivation und Schulung der Patient*innen
• Therapeutische Dokumentation und Verlaufsbeurteilung
• Aktive Mitarbeit beim Aufbau von Prozessen/Angeboten (Reha-Phasen II/III)
• Optional je nach Qualifikation/Interesse: Krafttraining, Atem-/Entspannungsverfahren, Stressbewältigung, Kursformate (z. B. Herzyoga/Wassertherapie) Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Gesundheitswesen (z. B. Physiotherapie, Sporttherapie, Pflege mit kardiologischer Zusatzqualifikation oder Studium der Sport-, Bewegungs- oder Gesundheitswissenschaften)
• Anerkannte Zusatzqualifikation in Herztherapie
• Gültige Notfallqualifikation BLS-AED
• Erfahrung in ambulanter kardialer Rehabilitation sowie der Rehabilitationsphasen II und III
• Berufseinsteiger*innen mit entsprechender Zusatzqualifikation willkommen
• Empathisch, selbstständig & strukturiert, kommunikations- und teamstark
• Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit und am Mitaufbau eines neuen Angebots Was wir bieten
• Mitgestaltung beim Aufbau eines neuen ambulanten Reha-Angebots
• Vierteljährliche interne Notfallschulungen
• Interdisziplinäres Arbeiten mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
• Moderne Infrastruktur und ein professionelles Umfeld Kontakt Ihre Bewerbungen senden Sie bitte an Frau Jeannette Leu j.leu.ergolz-klinik@hin.ch. Die Ergolz Klinik in Liestal ist seit 2012 Teil der kantonalen Spitalplanung. Wir stehen allen Versicherungsklassen offen und bieten ambulante wie stationäre medizinische Leistungen. Zu unseren Fachbereichen gehören u. a. Kardiologie, Allgemeine Chirurgie, Urologie, HNO-Chirurgie und Orthopädie. Corps: Thérapeute cardiaque – 40-60 % descrizione La clinique Ergolz de Liestal (BL) fait partie du groupe Cardiance et offre un environnement professionnel en médecine, soins, thérapie, administration et service. --- Mansioni - Planification et mise en œuvre de thérapies individuelles et collectives - Ajustement individuel de la formation en tenant compte des besoins médicaux - Instruction, motivation et formation des patients - Documentation thérapeutique et évaluation des cours - Coopération active dans les processus et les offres de construction (phases II/III de Reha) - Facultativement selon la qualification/l'intérêt: entraînement de la force, procédures de respiration/de stress, gestion du stress, formats de cours (par exemple yoga cardiaque/thérapie de l'eau) ---
• Requisiti - Accomplir une formation ou des études en soins de santé (p. ex. physiothérapie, thérapie sportive, soins avec une qualification complémentaire cardiologique ou études en sports, mouvements ou sciences de la santé) - Qualification supplémentaire accréditée en thérapie cardiaque - Qualification d'urgence valide BLS-AED - Expérience en réadaptation cardiaque ambulatoire et en phase II et III - Les débutants professionnels sont les bienvenus avec la qualification supplémentaire correspondante ---
• Cosa offriamo - Concevoir une nouvelle offre de réadaptation ambulatoire - Formation d'urgence interne trimestrielle - Travail interdisciplinaire avec des pistes de décision courtes - Infrastructures modernes et environnement professionnel --- Contatto Veuillez envoyer vos demandes à : Mme Jeannette Leu J.leu.ergolz-klinik@hin.ch --- Clinique: Ergolz Klinik, Liestal (BL) Adresse: Hammerstrasse 35, 4410 Liestal, Suisse Téléphone: +41 61 906 92 92 Télécopie: +41 61 906 92 70 Sito web: www.cardiance.com --- *La clinique Ergolz de Liestal fait partie de la planification de l'hôpital cantonal depuis 2012. Nous sommes ouverts à toutes les classes d'assurance et offrons des services médicaux ambulatoires. Nos domaines spécialisés comprennent la cardiologie, la chirurgie générale, l'urologie, la chirurgie ENT et l'orthopédie. *
